policy.on_capacity_failure: Retain existing snapshots and stop adding new ones; do not delete old backups.

sample.method: Six most recent snapshot directories measured with du -sk; the service capacity check uses current store bytes plus _estimated_bytes, which intentionally exceeds one snapshot's observed disk use.

forecast.rough_additional_snapshots_at_current_si: about 29 before the next capacity check may reject a new snapshot
forecast.risk_window: At a six-hour cadence, about seven days from this observation, potentially before a successful M2 followed by five trading sessions can finish. Future growth and host wakefulness make this a forecast, not a failure timestamp.

action: Asked the user whether to temporarily raise only this project's local backup cap to 8 GiB; no limit, retention policy, snapshot, or scheduler was changed in this observation.
limits: More local capacity would defer but not solve long-term retention or offsite disaster recovery. M2/M3 are not accepted.
